# Davao Digital

> Davao Digital is a web design and digital marketing studio in Davao City, Philippines. We design, build, host and maintain websites for small and growing businesses across Davao, Mindanao and the rest of the Philippines. Websites start at ₱10,000 one-time and go live in 7 days; an optional ₱3,000/month Care Plan covers hosting, updates, backups, local SEO and support. Every project starts with a free preview — we build the first version of the website before the client pays anything.

Key facts: based in Davao City, Davao del Sur, Philippines. Online-first studio (no walk-in
office). Languages: English, Filipino, Cebuano. Price range: ₱10,000–₱25,000+
for a website, plus ₱3,000/month for the Care Plan. Delivery: 7 days.
You own your domain and site files. No lock-in. Contact: davaodigital@gmail.com · +63 969 193 3721.
